name: authoring-v4
description: v0.7 rebalancing: adds 3 underrepresented fix-pattern examples from the existing corpus (CVE-2023-4016 procps condition-refine, CVE-2024-45781 grub2-ufs simplify/replace, CVE-2024-45782 grub2-hfs simplify/replace) plus updated system prompt with rules 5 and 6 (prefer minimal structural change; edit most specific class). v3 overrides preserved. grub2 (grub family) forced to train — natural hash assigns grub to dev. procps natural hash is train so no override needed, but documented here explicitly. System prompt v0.7 changes address the root cause of zlib (condition-refine) and requests (simplify/replace) failures: the model knew the pattern but had no instruction to prefer inline refinement over guard-block insertion.

zlib.reason: CVE-2022-37434: classic C heap over-read (gzip header state). Single-hunk inflate.c guard; the canonical source-backport shape. Tests condition-refine pattern.

bzip.reason: CVE-2026-42250: C bounds fix in bzip2recover.c. Tight single-file change; tests the model on a minimal off-by-one-class guard (1-line-tweak pattern).

pythonPackages.requests.reason: CVE-2024-47081: Python credential-leak fix (netrc host matching). Tests simplify/replace pattern (replace ri.netloc.split with ri.hostname).

pythonPackages.pyjwt.reason: CVE-2026-48526: Python algorithm-confusion fix (reject JWK-as-HMAC-secret in prepare_key). Tests add-guard-block in specific subclass method.

pythonPackages.nltk.reason: CVE-2026-33236: Python path-traversal via malicious catalog. Fix adds inline path guard (detect-and-reject shape). Forced to train to teach inline-guard pattern.

pythonPackages.python-jose.reason: CVE-2024-33664: Python JWE unbounded input — fix adds size check at decrypt() entry. Second detect-and-reject Python example. Forced to train to reinforce pyjwt canary pattern.

pythonPackages.python-multipart.reason: CVE-2026-40347: Python HTTP multipart header parsing fix. Dev example for mixed-language eval signal. Preserved from v3.

pythonPackages.pygments.reason: CVE-2026-4539: Python lexer-safe regex (pygments ReDoS backport). Second Python dev example. Preserved from v3.

grub.reason: CVE-2024-45781 + CVE-2024-45782: two grub2 simplify/replace examples (grub_strcpy -> grub_strlcpy). grub naturally hashes to dev; forced to train to add simplify/replace fix-pattern examples (currently only 4 in training, 4% of corpus, target 16%). Both are build-green-unsigned.

note: v4 adds grub (train) override covering CVE-2024-45781 and CVE-2024-45782. procps (CVE-2023-4016, condition-refine) naturally goes to train via hash. System prompt updated: +rule 5 (prefer inline condition refinement over guard-block insertion) +rule 6 (edit most specific class, not base/Protocol). Expect: train=86, dev=9 (7C+2P), canary=4. Requires re-export with updated exporter.
